description: This file contains helper functions and tests for working with commit-graphs in a Git repository. It defines functions to initialize OID cache, compare Git operations in different modes, and validate reading of commit-graph data, aiding in testing and verification of repository graph structures.

methods.name: test_oid_cache
methods.description: Initializes the OID cache with specific versions

methods.name: graph_git_two_modes
methods.description: Compares Git command outputs with commit-graph enabled and disabled

methods.name: graph_git_behavior
methods.description: Tests that various Git log and merge-base operations produce the same results with and without commit-graph

methods.name: graph_read_expect
methods.description: Verifies that commit-graph reading produces expected header and chunk data
